title: Flaky: TelemetryHookScriptTests pwsh hook process does not exit within 30 seconds on Windows
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Cli.Tests, Cli, Cli, tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests.cs... / Cli (windows-latest)
error_pattern: System.TimeoutException : Hook process 'pwsh' did not exit within 30 seconds.
analysis: Four separate TelemetryHookScriptTests test methods failed with the identical timeout waiting for a pwsh hook subprocess to exit on the windows-latest runner. This is a known recurring flaky-test pattern (tracked as issue #20121, previously seen with Pwsh_ReferenceFileRead_CopilotStringArgs_ForwardsRelativePath). The PR under test only modifies Aspire.Dashboard source and tests (DashboardOptions.cs, RepositoryFactory.cs, SqliteResourceRepository.cs/.Storage.cs, and related dashboard tests), which have no relationship to the Aspire.Cli hook script test infrastructure. The failure is environmental/timing-related (pwsh process launch/exit latency on Windows CI runners), not caused by the PR's changes.
